status: Legacy illustration provenance; runtime uses the approved cartoon set
usage: Ten shared raster illustrations inside SVG Chance/Community card images. Titles and descriptions are drawn as SVG text from getCard() so Vietnamese and board-specific rules stay exact.

layoutRevision.frame: 600x800 SVG; illustration fits in a separate 464x464 square using xMidYMid meet, with no clipping mask; native deck-colored header and thin border
layoutRevision.text: Separate title, description and optional destination regions; existing Vietnamese copy and effects unchanged
layoutRevision.review: 39 faces, both deck backs and festival destination variant; shared renderer used for gameplay and review sheets
layoutRevision.artwork: Existing WebP illustrations retained without modifying source images
